name: HZ_MERGE_DICTIONARY
description: The HZ_MERGE_DICTIONARY table stores information about the tables affected by a party merge. This table is used by the party merge concurrent program.

columns.name: MERGE_DICT_ID
columns.description: Sequence generated id to uniquely identify a record in the Dictionary

columns.name: APPLICATION_USAGE
columns.description: This column is to store usage information. Usage is a layer that ties the objects with same business context together. The objects that have the same usage will be processed in the same transaction. To ensure uniqueness, consuming teams need to prefix usage names with <ProductCode>_<LBA>

columns.name: FETCH_RECORD_FLAG
columns.description: This column is used to indicate if consumer wants TCH PL/SQL runtime to query its table and pass the records to its routine or not. If this flag set to Y, TCH PL/SQL runtime will query the records from consumer's table based on the information specified in the HZ_MERGE_DICTIONARY and pass the record one by one to consumer routine. If this flag set to N, TCH PL/SQL runtime will not query the records from consumer's table. Consuming team's routine has full control of doing merge/transfer/other actions on their entity, including using bulk mode. The default behavior for this column is Y.

columns.name: RULE_SET_NAME
columns.description: Name of the Rule Set. This will be seeded name for  Rel 1.  Users cannot alter the rule set value or create a new one.

columns.name: ENTITY_NAME
columns.description: Name of the entity

columns.name: PARENT_ENTITY_NAME
columns.description: Name of the parent entity

columns.name: PK_COLUMN_NAME
columns.description: Name of the Primary Key Column  for the entity

columns.name: FK_COLUMN_NAME
columns.description: Name of the Foreign Key Column  which links the entity to the parent

columns.name: DESC_COLUMN_NAME
columns.description: The name of the columns that will be used in generating a description for the record. Used in generating reports and logs. Eg: PARTY_NAME for HZ_PARTIESCould also be a complex concatenation or decode statement.

columns.name: PROCEDURE_TYPE
columns.description: Procedure Type.  Values allowed : BC4J, PL/SQL

columns.name: PROCEDURE_NAME
columns.description: Name of the Merge Procedure

columns.name: JOIN_CLAUSE
columns.description: Where Clause to related parent and child entity

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Short descriptive name for the entity. EG: 'Party' for HZ_PARTIES

columns.name: DICT_APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Dictionary application identifier

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: SEQUENCE_NO
columns.description: Sequence of the entity for merge.

columns.name: BULK_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the records in this table are being handled in bulk by the merge procedure. 'Y' for tables where merge is handled in bulk. 'N' for others.

columns.name: FK_DATA_TYPE
columns.description: Foreign key data type

columns.name: BATCH_MERGE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether merge procedure should be executed only once for a batch

columns.name: VALIDATE_PURGE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether purge validation should be skipped for an entity in the HZ Purge program.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
